n: A song of David, sung responsively: the leader begins, ‘If the Lord had not been on our side…’ and calls Israel to repeat it.
Repetition drives the point home: without God, when enemies attacked, all would have been lost.

f.w: the LORD who was on our side

n: Enemies would have swallowed them alive, like a monster or the grave. ‘Quick’ means alive.
A second image: a flash flood would have swept over them.

f.w: the stream had gone over our soul

n: The ‘proud,’ raging waters would have drowned them.
Praise God, who did not let them be torn apart by their enemies’ teeth like prey.
They escaped like a bird from a hunter’s trap — the trap broke and they flew free.
The closing confession: our help is in the name of the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.

f.w: Our help is in the name of the LORD
